purpose: Teach: 歯ブラシ/酪農/石器/ニワトリ/和紙/魚介類/アヒル/下駄

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店に新しい歯ブラシスタンドを置きましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's put a new toothbrush stand in the café.
lines.style: Warm, decisive suggestion. Gentle authority — the ease of someone comfortable planning small improvements. Slight lean forward. Soft opening, clear intention.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、酪農のお仕事だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, that regular customer — the one who works at a dairy farm, right?
lines.style: Soft realization dawning mid-sentence. Noticing something she'd tucked away. Warm half-smile in the voice. The pleasure of remembering someone's life.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、博物館で石器時代の展示を見られたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And that customer who saw the Stone Age exhibit at the museum — I remember now.
lines.style: Gentle, connecting dots. Quiet delight in the details of other people. Wondering tone. Pace slightly slower, like savoring the memory.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お祭りでニワトリ模様の屋台を見たね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We saw that stall with the chicken pattern at the festival, didn't we.
lines.style: Shared memory, no question. Soft affection in the recall. Glance sideways — this is theirs. Warm, settled tone. Slight smile in the delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店のメニュー、和紙にしましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: The café menu — we should print it on washi paper.
lines.style: Thoughtful, specific suggestion. Gentle but certain. The voice of someone imagining how something will look. Even pace, clear vision.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、魚介類のパスタ加えましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yes, let's add seafood pasta to the new menu.
lines.style: Energized agreement. Quick, bright rhythm. Forward momentum — enthusiasm building on Mei's idea. Slightly faster than before. Genuine interest in the execution.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、アヒルのおもちゃに夢中ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That child is completely absorbed in the little duck toy, isn't she.
lines.style: Soft observation, almost to herself. The warmth of watching someone young find joy. Gentle, unhurried. A smile underneath — tenderness without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、夏祭りに下駄でお見えになったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer came to the summer festival in wooden clogs — I'll never forget that.
lines.style: Warm, settled completion. The satisfaction of a small, vivid memory. Slight trailing softness. Intimate tone — sharing something noticed and treasured.
